beats.label: 古寺静场
beats.detail: In stillness, the white-robed keeper stands grounded, gaze lifted; the teal challenger watches from the north landing, only sash and flags breathing.

beats.label: 压膝蓄势
beats.detail: Slowly, the challenger bends his knees and draws his sword behind his hip, jaw tightening; the red sash pulls taut in the breeze.

beats.label: 抬眼待招
beats.detail: Deliberately, the keeper raises his eyes without stepping, his low blade steady; pale robe folds settle while the challenger holds compressed readiness.

beats.label: 蓄势停驻
beats.detail: Hold the loaded pose, both soles fixed and blades separated; determined challenger and composed keeper remain still as the flags move.

beats.label: 单一机位
beats.detail: A single slow dolly forward ends in a still wide two-shot with the north landing visible; one continuous shot, no cut.

continuity.exit: Challenger screen left on the north landing (0,8.4,1.2), facing south, knees compressed, right-hand sword behind his hip; keeper screen right at (0,0,0.15), facing north, right-hand sword lowered; no contact.

board.prompt:
Create ONE cinematic storyboard still, 16:9, premium painterly 3D Chinese wuxia animated feature, not a photo. Reference 1 = white keeper identity and clothing ONLY; reference 2 = teal challenger identity and clothing ONLY; reference 3 = courtyard architecture, materials and dusk palette ONLY, not its camera or exact staircase count. Exactly two adult men except when specified offscreen. One plain straight jian each, empty scabbards, no extra weapon. Same grey stone low dais, muted red flags, warm western rim light. No captions, text, panel layout or montage. Wide establishing view from southwest, camera 2.8m high, 28mm lens facing northeast across dais. White keeper full body central foreground screen right, teal challenger small screen left on the distant north stair landing, knees compressed, blade behind hip. Clear large separation. West broken columns frame left; bell tower distant northeast, tree southeast. Eight shallow steps, no giant staircase.
CRITICAL SPATIAL CORRECTION: The white keeper stands at the CENTER of the circular stone dais, both boots ON its flat top, NOT outside the dais, NOT on its front edge. The circular dais extends several metres around and in FRONT of his feet. Compose smaller keeper, wider camera, elevated 2.8m looking modestly down so the top surface and his central position are unmistakable. Challenger remains on distant stair landing screen left. Only EIGHT shallow risers, total height 1.2m, not a grand long staircase.
Spatial correction takes priority over the environment reference composition. Preserve illustrated cinematic quality. Draw a fresh composition from the specified side.

Do NOT copy image 2 composition: it is a DIFFERENT viewpoint or time. ivory pawn = keeper: crown at (60.8% from left, 43.5% from top), feet at (60.6%, 63.7%). Preserve this EXACT full-body size and position; grey-white robe, black topknot, lowered straight sword. blue-grey pawn = challenger: crown at (37.6% from left, 30.5% from top), feet at (37.7%, 43.6%). Preserve this EXACT full-body size and position; dark teal robe, red sash, high ponytail, straight sword. The figures must occupy those pixel locations on the canvas, not a prettier arrangement. Keep the white and blue identities attached to the correct pawn positions, even if their screen order differs from image2. Keep the original dais ellipse, stair silhouette, bell-tower and wall positions from image1. Image2 supplies mood only; image3 the keeper identity; image4 challenger identity; image5 architecture materials only. Rich painterly 3D wuxia animated-film finish, dusk stone textures, not a photograph. Remove all pawn/diagram artifacts, no captions. Current moment: In stillness, the white-robed keeper stands grounded, gaze lifted; the teal challenger watches from the north landing, only sash and flags breathing. STRUCTURAL VISIBILITY: bell tower centre is around (66% from left, 27% from top), only its portion shown in image1 is visible. north temple and staircase centre is around (38% from left, 33% from top), only its portion shown in image1 is visible. big tree centre is around (134% from left, 7% from top), only its portion shown in image1 is visible.
